docs.summary:
Complete visual configuration for an Origami widget tree.

Colour structure mirrors the host editor's theme: a Neutral surface ramp, branded ramps ([`Primary`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Primary), [`Blue`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Blue), [`Red`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Red), [`Green`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Green), [`Amber`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Amber)), and a foreground/text ramp ([`Ink`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Ink)). [`OrigamiVariant`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiVariant) picks which surface ramp a widget reads via [`Get`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Get).

Apply globally with [`SetTheme`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~SetTheme); scope to a region with [`PushTheme`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.Origami~PushTheme).
Neutral grayscale ramp — backgrounds, panels, default surfaces.
Brand ramp — used by the [`Primary`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiVariant~Primary) variant.
Blue ramp — used by the [`Info`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiVariant~Info) variant.
Red ramp — used by the [`Danger`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiVariant~Danger) variant.
Green ramp — used by the [`Success`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiVariant~Success) variant.
Amber ramp — used by the [`Warning`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiVariant~Warning) variant.

Text/foreground ramp. Same shape as the surface ramps so widgets read it uniformly. Conventions: `C100` dimmest (rarely used as text), `C300` muted/disabled, `C500` primary labels, `C600`/`C700` "extra bright" emphasis (typically used for hover/focused text on dark surfaces).
Inset "glass" fill for toolbars, headers, tag pills and search fields within a panel (translucent dark, distinct from the panel body).
Menu / dropdown / popover surface — more opaque than panels so it reads over anything.
Soft hairline border / divider (very low alpha).
Stronger border for focused / emphasised edges (e.g. popover outlines).
Drop-shadow colour for popovers, dropdowns and modals.
Hover overlay. Tracks [`Primary`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Primary) so a retint carries through.
Selected / active fill. Tracks [`Primary`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Primary).
Border of focused elements.
Glow around focused elements.
Scrollbar thumb.
Scrollbar thumb under the pointer.
The hairline between docked panels.
Tooltip background.

docs.summary: Return `c` with a new alpha (0-255). Handy for state overlays.
Regular (400) weight face. Widgets fall back to this when a heavier weight is unset.
Medium (500) weight face. Optional — falls back to [`Font`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Font).
Semi-bold (600) weight face. Optional — falls back to Medium then [`Font`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Font).
Bold (700) weight face. Optional — falls back to SemiBold, Medium, then [`Font`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Font).
Monospace face for value/code fields (numeric, vector, color, hex). Falls back to [`Font`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Font).
Resolved monospace face, or the regular face if none supplied.
Resolved medium (500) weight, or the regular face if none supplied.
Resolved semi-bold (600) weight, or the closest lighter face supplied.
Resolved bold (700) weight, or the closest lighter face supplied.

Map a variant to its surface ramp. [`Default`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiVariant~Default) and [`Subtle`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiVariant~Subtle) both point at [`Neutral`](#api~Prowl.OrigamiUI.OrigamiTheme~Neutral); widgets distinguish Subtle by treating low ramp stops as transparent (typically suppressing the idle background entirely).

members.signature: public static OrigamiTheme Lerp(OrigamiTheme a, OrigamiTheme b, float t)

docs.summary: Linearly interpolate the lerpable parts (ramps, ink, metrics) between two themes. Non-lerpable members (font, icons) snap to `b` at the start of the transition.
The default theme: Prowl's dark palette, Geist fonts and Font Awesome icons.
